admin_mfa_state_check.name: admin_mfa_state_check
admin_mfa_state_check.value:
("admin_mfa"."enabled_at" is null and "admin_mfa"."last_used_step" is null)
        or ("admin_mfa"."enabled_at" is not null and "admin_mfa"."encrypted_secret" is not null and "admin_mfa"."last_used_step" is not null)

operator_session_approval_check.name: operator_session_approval_check
operator_session_approval_check.value: ("operator_session"."approved_at" is null and "operator_session"."account_id" is null and "operator_session"."mfa_version" is null) or ("operator_session"."approved_at" is not null and "operator_session"."account_id" is not null and "operator_session"."mfa_version" is not null and "operator_session"."mfa_version" > 0 and "operator_session"."approved_at" >= "operator_session"."created_at" and "operator_session"."approved_at" < "operator_session"."expires_at")

operator_session_exchange_check.name: operator_session_exchange_check
operator_session_exchange_check.value: ("operator_session"."exchanged_at" is null and "operator_session"."token_hash" is null and "operator_session"."token_expires_at" is null) or ("operator_session"."exchanged_at" is not null and "operator_session"."approved_at" is not null and "operator_session"."exchanged_at" >= "operator_session"."approved_at" and "operator_session"."exchanged_at" < "operator_session"."expires_at" and "operator_session"."token_hash" is not null and "operator_session"."token_expires_at" is not null and "operator_session"."token_expires_at" > "operator_session"."exchanged_at")

operator_session_revocation_check.name: operator_session_revocation_check
operator_session_revocation_check.value: "operator_session"."revoked_at" is null or ("operator_session"."exchanged_at" is not null and "operator_session"."revoked_at" >= "operator_session"."exchanged_at")

service_policy_content_check.name: service_policy_content_check
service_policy_content_check.value:
case when jsonb_typeof("service_policy"."content") = 'array' then
      jsonb_array_length("service_policy"."content") between 1 and 100
      and not jsonb_path_exists("service_policy"."content", 'strict $[*] ? (@.type() != "string")')
      else false end

service_publication_shape_check.name: service_publication_shape_check
service_publication_shape_check.value:
case
      when "service_publication"."kind" = 'notice' then
        "service_publication"."category" is not null and length(btrim("service_publication"."category")) between 1 and 40
        and "service_publication"."release_version" is null and jsonb_typeof("service_publication"."content") = 'string'
        and length(btrim("service_publication"."content" #>> '{}')) between 1 and 20000
      when "service_publication"."kind" = 'update' then
        "service_publication"."category" is null and "service_publication"."release_version" is not null
        and length(btrim("service_publication"."release_version")) between 1 and 40
        and case when jsonb_typeof("service_publication"."content") = 'array' then
          jsonb_array_length("service_publication"."content") between 1 and 100
          and not jsonb_path_exists("service_publication"."content", 'strict $[*] ? (@.type() != "string")')
        else false end
      else false end

waveform_job_attempt_check.name: waveform_job_attempt_check
waveform_job_attempt_check.value: "waveform_job"."status" not in ('RUNNING','SUCCEEDED') or ("waveform_job"."attempt_id" is not null and "waveform_job"."started_at" is not null)

waveform_job_error_check.name: waveform_job_error_check
waveform_job_error_check.value: case when "waveform_job"."status" = 'FAILED' then "waveform_job"."error_code" is not null and "waveform_job"."error_code" in ('ENQUEUE_FAILED','PROCESSING_FAILED','DLQ','DELIVERY_EXPIRED','SOURCE_CHANGED') else "waveform_job"."error_code" is null end
